frontmatter.title: How to Build a Versioned, Testable, and Model-Agnostic Prompt Library
frontmatter.subheading: A Practical Guide to Structuring, Versioning, and Evaluating AI Prompts at Scale
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn how to architect a prompt library that evolves safely. This guide covers version control, dynamic templating, prompt evaluation pipelines, and model adapters to ensure your prompts remain consistent, traceable, and adaptable across AI models.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
